title: Agent Certificate v0 Claim Template Catalog
description: The pinned v0 claim-template catalog record shape. Claim sentences are versioned templates, never user-controlled prose. Seven bounded future-evolution templates remain pinned here, while current ClaimV0 emission is fail-closed to D2 and G1 tier 1; B1, REG1, C1, F1, and G3 template records are retained for isolated payload/template tests but are unprintable until registered verifier evidence and policy gates exist. A renderer substitutes bounded parameters into these immutable template_text constants; no private artifact content or free text crosses.

TemplateB1V1.description: Future registered B1 template shape. Current v0 ClaimV0 rejects B1 because the PASS verifier is unavailable until the manifest/signature/audit cycle is finalized. If registered later, the sentence remains limited to the issuer signing a named seal statement, never sealed-history integrity.

template_text.const: The issuer signed this seal statement: seal {seal_ref}, canonical seal-statement digest {seal_statement_digest}.

TemplateREG1V1.description: Future registered REG1 template shape. REG1 is pending matrix registration and current v0 ClaimV0 rejects it. The pinned sentence retains the bounded receipt scope and cannot be emitted until registration lands.

template_text.const: Registry record {registry_record_ref} of kind {registry_kind} holds a commitment under scheme {commitment_scheme} with canonical record digest {canonical_record_digest}. This receipt attests bytes, identifier, and server-recorded time only — not truth, authorship, or completeness.

TemplateC1V1.description: Future registered C1 template shape. Current v0 ClaimV0 rejects C1 because its PASS verifier depends on the finalized manifest/signature/audit cycle. The artifact-scoped sentence remains distinct from the prohibited global unsupported-claims form.

template_text.const: Within this certificate artifact only: every printed claim resolved to a registered template, a versioned verifier run recording PASS, and bound evidence digests, under compiler {compiler_version}, semantics manifest {semantics_manifest_digest}, prohibited-claims register {prohibited_register_digest}, and verifier catalog {verifier_catalog_digest}. This sentence says nothing about the agent, its outputs, or any content outside this artifact.

TemplateD2V1.description: Claim D2 (offline zero-Traigent-backend-egress), 'the sole runtime-witnessed row in the supplied evidence, and even it must remain precisely scoped to the attestation mode and SDK witness identified' (C6 v0 set). Scoped to a pinned SDK ref and declared workload class; merged prohibited claim 16 bars any offline zero-egress wording 'beyond the exact attested run or pinned SDK witness scope', and real-model runs necessarily egress to the model provider — the claim is about Traigent-backend egress only.

template_text.const: Runs referenced by this certificate declared data-flow mode offline. Zero Traigent-backend egress was witnessed by {witness_kind} at SDK ref {sdk_ref} for workload class {workload_class}, witness bundle {witness_bundle_digest}. This witnesses that workload shape at that ref only; it is not a claim about other code paths, other refs, or egress to model providers.

TemplateF1V1.description: Future registered F1 template shape. Current v0 ClaimV0 rejects F1 because its PASS verifier depends on the finalized manifest/signature/audit cycle. The sentence refers to the sibling signature block rather than creating a self-referential digest fixed point.

template_text.const: The issuer signature over this certificate's declared unsigned-manifest digest verifies under {signature_scheme} with key {issuer_key_ref} in trust ring {trust_ring_ref}. It proves issuance and post-issuance integrity only, not the truth or completeness of any claim.

TemplateG1V1.description: Claim G1 (client evidence-manifest commitment). A commitment proves possession at commit time only; completeness of the committed manifest is NOT claimed (standing non-claim NC_STEP_CAPTURE), and low-entropy preimages are guessable without secret blinding — the only registered scheme is secret-blinded (certification_common_v0_schema.json#/definitions/CommitmentSchemeV0).

template_text.const: The client committed evidence-manifest root {manifest_root_digest} under scheme {commitment_scheme} using client attestor version {client_attestor_version}. The commitment proves the client held this manifest at commit time; it does not prove the manifest is complete.

TemplateG3V1.description: Future registered G3 template shape. Current v0 ClaimV0 rejects G3 because its PASS verifier depends on the finalized manifest/signature/audit cycle. The sentence remains limited to co-signed bytes and does not assert server truth.

template_text.const: Client key {client_key_ref} co-signed this certificate's declared unsigned-manifest digest. The client attests that these are the exact bytes it co-signed — not that any server assertion covered by them is true.
